subject: School District Strategic Planning
overview: Lisa Kingsley hosted a coffee chat with second-grader Caroline Kingsley to discuss the concept and importance of creating a strategic plan for the school district.

items.title: Introduction
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley introduced her guest, Caroline Kingsley, a second-grade student at the Brooks School.

items.title: Discussion on Strategic Planning
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley explained the purpose of strategic planning and why the school district needs a plan to avoid making mistakes.

items.title: Closing
items.summary: Caroline Kingsley concluded the coffee chat.
